question: Which company invested ₹11,400 crores during the financial year 2019-2020 across its market payments and wholesale business units in India to strengthen its foothold in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Amazon.com Inc**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Amazon.com Inc.**__

 __
 
• **It is an American Multinational Technology company that focuses on e-commerce, cloud computing, digital streaming, and artificial intelligence.**
 
• **Headquarters**: Seattle, Washington
 
• **Founder**: Jeff Bezos
 
• **Founded**: 1994
 
• **CEO**: Andy Jassy
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Walmart Inc.**__

 __
 
• It is an American multinational retail corporation that operates a chain of hypermarkets, discount department stores, and grocery stores.
 
• **Headquarters**: Arkansas
 
• **Founder**: Sam Walton
 
• **Founded**: 1962
 
• **CEO**: Doug McMilon
 
 
 
• **Apple Inc.**__
 __
 
• Apple Inc. is an American multinational technology company that specializes in consumer electronics, software, and online services.
 
• **Headquarters**: California
 
• **Founder:** Steve Jobs
 
• **Founded**: 1976
 
• **CEO**: Tim Cook
 
 
 
• **eBay Inc.**__
 
 
• It is an American multinational e-commerce corporation that facilitates consumer-to-consumer and business-to-business sales through its website.
 
• **Headquarters**: California
 
• **Founder**: Pierre Omidyar
 
• **Founder**: 1995
 
• **CEO**: Jamie Lannon
